notice.title: Vacancy Circular received from the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India Delhi Inviting applications from sutable and eligible officers for the post of Assistant Registrar (Computer), on deputation basis.

age_as_on.evidence: The candidates should be below 56 years as on 1st August, 2026

limits.evidence: The candidates should be below 56 years as on 1st August, 2026

pay.evidence: Applications in the prescribed format are invited from eligible officers under Central Government/State Government/Universities/recognized Research Institutes or any High Court having the following qualifications and other eligibility conditions as on 1st August, 2026 for selection for appointment…

clauses.text: Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Computer Applications or B.E., in Computers or IT or B.Tech. in Computers from a recognized University or equivalent
Educational Qualifications (attach copies of certificates from 10th Class onwards duly attested by Gazetted Officer)
